messages:
incident-bot: Pager: inference-runtime latency spike (SEV2) | route=/v1/generate | pool=dedicated-us-west-2-2 | started 2026-03-15T02:12:24Z
lee_oncall: Taking pager. Looking at traces and RTVs. Picking up live.
sam_eng: I'm joining, saw kv_cache_evictions jump and batch wait p95 climb. Noticed a model variant deploy yesterday afternoon.
mari_sre: Noted 3 paying tenants showing elevated p95; TVR ~3.2x for one tenant. Logging customer impact.
lee_oncall: Correlating metrics: eviction storm -> increased tail latency -> batching backlog. Suspect cache thrash.
sam_eng: Quick hypothesis: quant v1.4.2 reduces memory per tensor in some ops but changed working set, small bump in resident mem -> more evicts under mixed seq lengths.
lee_oncall: Action: start fallback to previous non-quant model on that pool. Rolling now.
lee_oncall: Command run:
```
redwood rollout apply --pool dedicated-us-west-2-2 --model rwd/open-ggml-v2@v1.4.1 --force-fallback
```
devops_bot: Rollout started -> monitoring hooks attached at 2026-03-15T02:24:10Z.
pm_jordan: I've alerted account contacts and updated status page (latency degraded). No escalations so far.
sam_eng: While rollback proceeds, recommend lowering batch_max and disabling cross-request batching for latency-sensitive routes. I'll push config.
lee_oncall: Applied config tweak: batch_max 16, cross_request_batching=false for /v1/generate on affected pool.
devops_bot: Config applied 2026-03-15T02:31:08Z.
mari_sre: Monitoring shows p95 coming down ~6m after rollback; kv evict rate trending to baseline. Good sign.
lee_oncall: Live pager clear, handoff to day team for postmortem + remediation tracking. Summary: root cause likely quant variant memory profile change causing KV eviction thrash and batching waits; temporary mitigations applied.
lee_oncall: Handoff checklist posted in incident doc. Will keep this thread for remediation tracking until actions are closed.
sam_eng: Proposed remediation items:
- Quant rollout gating: add memory/resident-set checks and a simulated KV pressure test in preflight.
- KV backpressure: introduce an eviction-rate-derived backpressure signal to routing to reduce new requests when thrash detected.
- Batching improvements: dynamic batch timeouts based on sequence-length distribution and backlog.
- Canarying: automated small-traffic canary for model variant rollouts on dedicated pools.

mari_sre: Assigning owners and due dates:
- sam_eng -> measure and report memory delta between v1.4.2 and v1.4.1; due 2026-03-18
- tay_func -> prototype KV eviction backpressure signal; due 2026-03-22
- lee_oncall -> draft postmortem + schedule review meeting; due 2026-03-17
- infra_ops -> add batch_max tuning runbook for oncall; due 2026-03-19

pm_jordan: Scheduling postmortem 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC. Invites: eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml, sres, product/PMs for affected tenants.
lee_oncall: Draft postmortem located: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/4922223345 (will attach timeline, graphs, conf diffs).
sam_eng: I'll add test harness to simulate heavy-wide sequence workload and KV pressure; will post results to the doc.
tay_func: Started branch git/infra/kv-backpressure-wip; will bring telemetry and a short prototype to postmortem.
mari_sre: Please include rollback timeline and cost estimate (approx 12 GPU-hours at higher perf tier) in the doc.
lee_oncall: Noted. Customer impact summary: 3 tenants with degraded latency for ~9 minutes window; no errors or data loss observed; no PII exposure.
lee_oncall: Open actions tracked in postmortem doc table; will update as items progress. Closing live pager now, moving to remediation follow-up.
pm_jordan: thanks everyone, cc @lead_cs for customer follow-ups.
sam_eng: ack :thumbsup:
mari_sre: good catch and fast rollback.
lee_oncall: final timestamps for record: incident start 2026-03-15T02:12:24Z (ts=4922223345), pager cleared 2026-03-15T02:40:00Z (ts=4922224000). Will update postmortem with final metrics and graphs.
